name: Immunoglobulin M (IgM)
short_description: The largest human antibody and the first responder of the immune system - normally a star/wheel-shaped PENTAMER of five Y-shaped monomers, their Fc stems joined at a central hub by a single J chain, with all ten Fab arms pointing outward; flat in solution, it bends into a staple/umbrella shape once it grips a multivalent antigen surface.
